reminders.title: Share the Good News
reminders.body: Who in your life needs to hear about God's love today?

reminders.title: You Are His Witness
reminders.body: God placed you in someone's life for a reason. Speak boldly about what Jesus has done for you.

reminders.title: Light in the Darkness
reminders.body: Let your light shine before others so they may see your good works and glorify your Father in heaven.

reminders.title: Go and Make Disciples
reminders.body: The Great Commission is for every believer. Who can you invite to know Jesus today?

reminders.title: One Seed at a Time
reminders.body: You may plant, another may water, but God gives the growth. Share the gospel faithfully.

reminders.title: Always Be Ready
reminders.body: Be prepared to give an answer to anyone who asks about the hope you have in Christ.

reminders.title: The Harvest Is Plentiful
reminders.body: Look around you — there are people ready to hear the gospel. Pray for open doors today.

reminders.title: No Shame in the Gospel
reminders.body: The gospel is the power of God that brings salvation to everyone who believes. Never be ashamed to share it.

reminders.title: Love Your Neighbor
reminders.body: The greatest act of love is pointing someone to Jesus. Who is your neighbor today?

reminders.title: Speak Life
reminders.body: Your testimony is powerful. Share what Jesus has done in your life — it could change someone's eternity.

reminders.title: Reconcilers for Christ
reminders.body: God has given us the ministry of reconciliation. We are ambassadors for Christ — share that message today.

reminders.title: Open Your Mouth Boldly
reminders.body: Ask God for boldness to proclaim the mystery of the gospel wherever you go today.

reminders.title: Beautiful Feet
reminders.body: How beautiful are the feet of those who bring good news! Your willingness to share matters.

reminders.title: Pray for Open Doors
reminders.body: Ask God to open a door today for a conversation about Jesus. He will be faithful to answer.

reminders.title: Salt and Light
reminders.body: You are the salt of the earth and a city on a hill. Live and speak in a way that points others to God.

reminders.title: Urgency of the Gospel
reminders.body: How will they hear without someone telling them? Your voice could be the one that leads someone home.

reminders.title: The Joy of Sharing
reminders.body: Sharing the gospel is a privilege, not a burden. Rejoice today in being used by God to reach others.

reminders.title: Jesus — the Only Way
reminders.body: There is salvation in no one else. Lovingly share the truth that Jesus is the way, the truth, and the life.

reminders.title: God's Word Never Returns Empty
reminders.body: Don't worry about the results — just be faithful to share. God's Word always accomplishes His purpose.

reminders.title: Run and Don't Grow Weary
reminders.body: Keep sharing the gospel even when it feels hard. God rewards those who sow seeds of His kingdom faithfully.
